units.source_text: 这住处与京都隔着好几重山，绝无人来访问。

en.t: This dwelling was separated from Kyoto by range after range of mountains, and absolutely no one came to visit.

units.source_text: 只有形容古怪的山农、村俗不堪的樵夫牧子，偶尔出入其中，为邸内服役。

en.t: Only strange-looking mountain farmers, unbearably rustic woodcutters, and young herders came and went from time to time, serving within the estate.

units.source_text: 八亲王心头的愁绪，像峰顶的朝雾一般永不消散，暮去朝来，日复一日。

en.t: The sorrow in Prince Hachi's heart, like morning mist over the peaks, never dispersed; evening passed into morning, day after day.

units.source_text: 此时正好有一位道行高深的阿阇梨住在这宇治山中。

en.t: At that time, an Ajari of profound spiritual attainment happened to be living in these mountains of Uji.

units.source_text: 这阿阇梨学问渊博，世间声名亦很盛大，

en.t: This Ajari was deeply learned, and his reputation in the world was also very great,

units.source_text: 但朝廷有佛事时，也极难得应召，一直闲居在这山中。

en.t: but even when the court held Buddhist rites, he seldom answered its summons, and continued to live quietly in these mountains.

units.source_text: 八亲王所居离开这阿阇梨住处甚近，

en.t: Prince Hachi's residence was very close to the place where this Ajari lived,

units.source_text: 他在闲寂的生涯中研习佛道，遇有经文中疑义，常去请教。

en.t: and in his quiet, secluded life he studied the Buddhist path; whenever questions arose in the scriptures, he often went to ask for instruction.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨也尊敬八亲王，常来山庄拜访。

en.t: The Ajari also respected Prince Hachi and often came to visit him at the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 他就八亲王年来所学得的教义，作深刻详细的解释。

en.t: He gave deep and detailed explanations of the teachings Prince Hachi had studied over the years.

units.source_text: 八亲王更加深信人世的短暂与乏味，便毫不隐讳地和他谈话：

en.t: Prince Hachi became still more convinced of the brevity and emptiness of human life, and spoke with him without the least concealment:

units.source_text: “我这颗心已经登上极乐净土的莲台，安住在清净无垢的八功德池中了。

en.t: "This heart of mine has already climbed onto the lotus dais of the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss and rests in the pure, unstained waters of the Eight Virtues Pond.

units.source_text: 惟有这两个年幼的孩子难于抛舍，心有牵挂，以致未能毅然出家。”

en.t: Only these two young children are hard for me to abandon; because my heart is still attached to them, I have been unable to resolutely leave the world."
